body: Second resource on top of cooldowns -- mp/max_mp on ArenaHero, flat per-slot costs (Q20/W20/R45) hooked through the existing cast_cooldown() choke point across all 63 landed-cast sites. Free-toggle W's now cost mana to activate (deactivate free). Blocked casts behave like whiffs. 12 new tests, full suite 366 checks, live-verified stable. Commit 9ad4369.
title: Mana resource layer, roster-wide (S170-132)
